question: By whose grace has the determination of the Kaula teaching been understood?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Understanding occurred by that lord's grace
What is known is the determination of Kaula
inference: Therefore the speaker claims to have understood the Kaula determination through the lord's grace.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
